title: The Seven Trumpets
intro: When the seventh seal is opened, seven angels with trumpets appear. Each trumpet announces a judgment upon the earth.

items.title: Hail and Fire
items.text: Hail and fire mixed with blood are thrown to the earth. A third of the trees are burned up.

items.title: Burning Mountain
items.text: A burning mountain is thrown into the sea. A third of the sea becomes blood.

items.title: Star Wormwood
items.text: A star falls and poisons a third of the rivers. Many die.

items.title: Darkness
items.text: A third of the sun, moon, and stars are darkened.

items.title: Locusts from the Abyss
items.text: Locusts with scorpion stings torment people for five months.

items.title: Army of 200 Million
items.text: Four angels are released. A third of mankind is killed.

items.title: God's Kingdom Comes
items.text: Loud voices in heaven: "The kingdom of the world has become our Lord!"
